image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a motorcycle front wheel assembly featuring a dual-disc brake system. The image prominently displays two cross-drilled steel rotors, a red telescopic fork leg, and a black caliper with blue accents mounted on the left rotor. A gold-colored axle nut and hub assembly are visible in the center. The background is blurred (bokeh), emphasizing the mechanical details.
